name: Anthony Algorithm - Relics (东尼算法 - 遗物)
author: omp
description: A faithful reimplementation of the Anthony algorithm (Auto-Anthonyology): the native card set is split offline into atomic fragments, and each run samples them back together from a single pool, so conditions and effects recombine freely - any legal condition can end up attached to any legal effect. The generation pool data is derived from Alriph's Auto-Anthonyology (mod id AutoAnthony); the generator, interpreter and rendering are an independent reimplementation. Standalone; no AutoAnthony dependency.
